FLoRA audit decisions

The status of every proposed FLoRA correction, with its evidence. Decisions save to a shared log for all reviewers. Nothing here changes FLoRA.

Shared with everyone using this review link. Names are self-reported.

    About this review

    Explore field decisions, supporting evidence, and correction proposals. Each case shows what is wrong with a FLoRA record, the current and proposed values, the evidence, and any dependency that must be settled first.

    “Audited” values come from the frozen FLoRA snapshot that was audited; “current” values come from the FLoRA release named on the Where things stand page. Recording a decision never changes FLoRA: decisions are saved in a shared Google-backed change log, and an exported file is a list of decisions for whoever applies the changes. The browser keeps pending writes until the shared service confirms them. Other reviewers’ changes load automatically or with Refresh shared decisions. In audit notes, “parent” means the integrating reviewer who applies decisions.

    Shortened evidence excerpts are embedded in this page.

    Keyboard

    A
    Approve the proposal, add the pair or accept the finding
    C
    Keep FLoRA as it is
    F
    Mark for follow-up
    1–9
    Choose a numbered policy option
    J K
    Next or previous case in the list
    N
    Next case without a decision
    U
    Undo the last decision
    /
    Search
